0.text: Leave Pallet Town north onto Route 1.
0.hint: The north exit is a two-tile gap in the top tree line, north of the open ground between the two houses. Walk to it, then straight up. Do not walk south into the water.
0.heading: up

12.text: Walk north through Route 1 to Viridian City.
12.hint: Route 1 runs straight north to Viridian City. Ledges only drop south.
12.heading: up

1.text: Head north through Viridian City onto Route 2.
1.hint: With the Pokédex the old man steps aside. Viridian's north exit leads to Route 2.
1.heading: up

42.text: Leave the Mart: back out of the shop list with B, choose QUIT, then walk out.
42.hint: The exit mat is at the bottom of the Mart.
42.heading: down

50.text: Walk through the gate into Viridian Forest.
50.hint: The forest door is at the top of the gate.
50.heading: up

51.text: Cross Viridian Forest to its north gate.
51.hint: The forest is a maze. The exit is at the top-left corner; go up the east side first, then west along the top.
51.heading: up

47.text: Leave the north gate onto Route 2.
47.hint: The exit is at the top of the gate.
47.heading: up

2.hint: The gym is the large building in the middle of the city.

54.text: Walk up to Brock and challenge him.
54.hint: Brock stands at the top of the gym. Face him and press A.
54.heading: up
